id: K17/R02 separate worker process takeover race
scenario: Parent holds a transaction that takes over the encode job from attempt A to attempt B.
A separate Node/tsx process reads the old A snapshot and attempts the real SELF_HLS finalizer.
Parent observes process A waiting on the PostgreSQL job-row FOR UPDATE lock, then commits B's takeover.
Process A is rejected as stale; a separate process for B finalizes and activates only B's asset and route.
limitations: Uses local PostgreSQL and synthetic fixtures; does not exercise R2/S3 or physical object cleanup.
Does not run the full FFmpeg/download/upload worker lifecycle.
Independent review and non-production provider acceptance remain outstanding; K17/R02 stays partial.
